findings.evidenceJa: 流れ出る液体を全身に塗りたくる
findings.governingReading: 塗りたくる names the creature’s deliberate spreading of liquid as supposed protection.
findings.explanation: Smearing liquid all over itself becomes flowing liquid covering it.

findings.highlight: she naturally thought that it might be able to do it for her.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分にはソレが出来るコトに気がついた
findings.governingReading: 自分にはソレが出来る assigns the capacity to her, with ソレ the elimination she imagined.
findings.explanation: Realizing she herself can do it becomes thinking an it might do it for her.

findings.evidenceJa: おかしな妄想にではない
findings.governingReading: おかしな妄想にではない negates the cause of dizziness, then identifies fear at genuinely finding the idea fun.
findings.explanation: Not being dizzy from the strange fantasy becomes it not being a strange delusion.

findings.highlight: She isn't afraid of falling asleep forever.
findings.evidenceJa: 手足がきかなくなって、一生寝たきりでも怖くはない
findings.governingReading: 一生寝たきり follows possible inability to use limbs; she could accept bodily disability but not loss of self.
findings.explanation: Being bedridden for life becomes sleeping forever.

findings.highlight: the one and only person who wants her to become happy.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女が幸せになってほしいと願うただ一人の人間
findings.governingReading: 彼女が幸せになってほしいと願う modifies the person whose happiness SHE wishes, whom she fears ruining for her own happiness.
findings.explanation: The one person she wishes happy becomes the one person who wishes her happy.
